title: Microwaves
summary: Claims that microwave ovens cause cancer, make food radioactive, or destroy nutrients through dangerous radiation.
introduction: Despite decades of scientific research confirming their safety, microwave ovens remain subject to persistent myths about causing cancer, making food radioactive, or destroying nutrients through harmful radiation. These myths often stem from misunderstanding the difference between ionizing and non-ionizing radiation, or from outdated or debunked studies that have been misinterpreted or taken out of context.
